correctness.rationale: Count generator on transient k=1,2,3 has T=[[-1-2c,2c,0],[2,-2-2c,2c],[0,3,-3]], initial (.5,0,.5). Its survival Laplace resolvent numerator V=z^2+(11+8c)z/2+(17+14c+8c^2)/2 and denominator D=z^3+(6+4c)z^2+(11+8c+4c^2)z+6 satisfy resultant(D,V)=-(c-1)(4c^2+5c+6). The sole nonnegative residue crossing at c=1 cancels middle pole -3. Initial h'(0)=-1/4-c; for c<1 negative middle spectral coefficient makes h'(t)>0 eventually and 3-mode exponential sign variation has at most one crossing. For c>=1 positive surviving coefficients force h'<0. For <=2 occupied sites, at most two exponentials give constant-sign hazard derivative. c=0 formula and boundary c=1 cancellation checked; inspected symbolic/labeled-state verify.py. This is not a claim for arbitrary 3-site initial distributions.
